cards.title: Pediatrician: Human Connection Matters More Than AI
cards.body: A pediatrician argues that loss of human connection, not screens, is the biggest threat to children's wellbeing. The solution lies in spending more time talking openly with kids rather than worrying about technology itself.

cards.title: Adult Kids Living at Home: Making It Work
cards.body: With record numbers of adult children staying with parents, experts recommend setting clear ground rules from the start and respecting each other's privacy. Avoid reverting to old parent-child dynamics for a peaceful arrangement.

cards.title: Benefits of Having an Older Sibling in Adolescence
cards.body: Older siblings influence younger siblings in ways parents cannot, serving as trusted role models and mentors. This relationship can be especially valuable during the adolescent years.

cards.title: Supporting Parents When Infants Cry Excessively
cards.body: When babies cry excessively, parents often struggle with stress and burnout. New research highlights that parent-focused support is just as important as helping the baby.

cards.title: Flawed Study Shaped Childhood Depression Treatment
cards.body: A single flawed study influenced clinical guidance for prescribing Prozac to children with depression. Fortunately, science is self-correcting and updated guidelines reflect more accurate evidence.
